message: The emulation didn't fail on any logic, which is good news: no test failures were reported, and the design and its no-refund, no-CRM-write rules are intact. The run was blocked because none of the supported typed contracts covers these Azure parts yet. Sign-in, App Service, Functions, AI Search and the Blob knowledge store need native generators, and the browser, ticket queue and CRM need plans for referencing or importing existing systems. That is product engineering work, not a design flaw. Swapping in the narrow Azure private-object-storage contract would only make the run look greener while removing the scope you asked for, so I'm leaving the board unchanged and nothing was mocked or validated against a real model. The reproducer is artifact c423a0f1…, revision 2, with 8 blockers. While that work is pending, we can close one real design decision: should retrieval be keyword, vector or hybrid search? Your answer decides the AI Search index setup and whether we need an embedding model deployment.
